parsed.answer: Immediately after the August 8 meeting, batch delivery using BATCH-0-741 remained approved for Mara’s Larch project; the tested recovery procedure did not change the delivery mode.

citations.quote: They chose BATCH-0-741 for batch delivery.
No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
